{{Quote|Niner, Bel&hellip;look after the ships.''"<br />"''Yes, sir.|CC-3714|audio=LookAfterTheShips-LoG.flac|<ref name="log" />}}
'''Bel''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As a member of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil's]] [[Fil's Squad/Legends|squad]], Bel accompanied recently promoted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]] during a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|mission]] to the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to capture [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. Before the [[Squad/Legends|group]] entered a [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] belonging to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in search of Gunray, Fil paired Bel with fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Niner/Legends|Niner]] and ordered both to stay outside and patrol the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]' [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Eventually, Fil ordered Bel and Niner to contact the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] for more clone [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] reinforcements. While the clone troopers boarded the vehicle, one of Grievous' [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]] used a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] to destroy the Republic [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Bel and Niner.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Better warm up the shuttle's long range transmitter.|Niner, to Bel|audio=WarmUpTransmitter-LoG.flac|<ref name="log" />}}
[[File:Bel_Niner.png|thumb|left|200px|Bel and Niner stand guard over their shuttle.]]
Bel was the name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]<ref name="log" /> who was [[Cloning/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Sometime in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ERC" /> Bel served under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil]] during a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|mission]] to the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]]. The mission's objective was to capture [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who had recently been [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|rescued]] from Republic captivity.<ref name="log" />

Bel accompanied recently promoted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]], who was leading the mission with Fil. The [[Fil's Squad/Legends|squad]] waited for Vebb's former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], before entering a nearby [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] belonging to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], in pursuit of Gunray. Fil paired Bel with fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Niner/Legends|Niner]] and ordered both to stay behind and watch after their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]]. After Fisto's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R6-H5/Legends|R6-H5]], tracked an approaching [[Soulless One/Legends|starfighter]] that resembled Grievous' [[Starship/Legends|starship]], Bel and Niner contacted Fisto, who was inside the castle, to alert the [[Squad/Legends|group]]. Eventually, Bel and Niner received a transmission from Fil inside the castle, telling both clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] to contact the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] near the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine]] for more clone trooper reinforcements. Unbeknownst to the clones, one of Grievous' [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] had spotted them. As Bel and Niner entered the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to contact the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the MagnaGuard used a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] to destroy the shuttle, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Bel and Niner.<ref name="log" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> Bel stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" /> [[Gender/Legends|He]] wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] that sported [[Color/Legends|red]] markings, and also used a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]]. On the third [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of Vassek, Bel obeyed the orders given to him by his squad leader, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Fil.<ref name="log" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bel was first featured in "[[Lair of Grievous]]," the tenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[December 12]], [[2008]]. The character was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all of the clone troopers in the series.<ref name="log guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode010.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lair of Grievous}}</ref> Prior to the episode's release, Bel was first mentioned in<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|67|Bel}}</ref> the [[December 9]], 2008,<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Bel's name was misspelled as "Bell" in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season One Episode Guide, Part One|''Season One Episode Guide'']] included in the [[Star Wars Insider 106|106th]] issue of [[Star Wars Insider|''Star Wars Insider'']]. The article was written by [[Sarah Herman]]<ref name="Insider 106">{{InsiderCite|106|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season One Episode Guide, Part One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season One Episode Guide, Part One}}</ref> released on [[December 17]], [[2008]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars Insider 105|''Star Wars Insider'' 105]]</ref>
